title: Startups for the Rest of Us #834 (Rob Walling) — Eric on Incorruptible, revisiting Lean Startup 15 years on
summary: Rob Walling — TinySeed managing partner and long-running host of Startups For the Rest of Us — publishes a launch-day Eric episode revisiting the Lean Startup thesis 15 years later and unpacking Incorruptible's redefinition of profit as human flourishing. Covers Costco's Sol Price roots and why AI can't do the founder learning.
blockquote: To make a profit is simply to maximize human flourishing. If we leave human beings better off than we found them, we have created profit.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Startups For the Rest of Us
